title: Build a Personal World, Not Just a Brand
one_liner: Use a 3-step creative identity framework to become the niche instead of blending in.
key_points: List everything you love to reveal what makes you uniquely you
Distill your list into 3–5 core pillars (e.g. rap, Miami, 80s design, spirituality)
Build a mood board from those pillars and reference it before every post or brand decision
Your unique combination of interests becomes your creative identity — that's what attracts your audience
